correctness.rationale: Proof checked for all dimensions: convex symmetric numerical-range support has h=||Re(e^{-iθ}T)||, period π, and contains ±R after phase rotation. Every integrand in Δ is nonnegative. A support point with imaginary coordinate b generates a one-sided interval of length arctan(b/R); elementary integration yields Δ≥R²/(2π)[s+(s²−1)arctan s]≥b³/(2πR)≥d³/(2πR). The distance identity follows from the contractive imaginary-part projection, with minimizing phase by continuity. Equality at Δ=0 is characterized exactly. In the 4×4 diagonal example angular support and distance are computed directly; Δ~4ε³/(3π), d~ε, excluding every stronger exponent. Finite checker independently reproduces the explicit numerical formula, not the infinite-dimensional proof.
